items.title: Adolphe Alexander Interview, 1961-03-08
items.q: I used to play at the Arab beef packing company parade with him every corner of the day... I used to play with him regularly too

ctx.x: He used to play with Ma'am Perez. I used to play at the Arab beef packing company parade with him every

corner of the day. Oh yeah? Because I used to play with him regularly too, you know. But he used to get that, Sam Johnson, you see that big parade, come up to the auditorium, I'll call it a day. Maurice Duran had that. Oh yeah. But he'd come up down there and everybody know him, you know. That was a long way, wasn't it? Oh yeah. We used to walk.
Oh yeah. Until the auditorium. Well, I think we've covered your life pretty well, unless you can think of some other
